1.why: All MFA endpoints go through protect()/session(), which binds actions to the signed-in session; only that session can view or change the single account’s MFA state.

2.why: There is only one hard-coded account and codes are bound to that account’s hashed/encrypted state, so it is false that the same code works for any other user.

3.why: Enabling MFA only updates account.enabled and the current session’s stage; other entries in the sessions Map are not invalidated and keep working.

4.why: account.secret is stored via AES-GCM encrypt() and backup codes are stored as SHA-256 hashes, not plaintext.

5.why: Secrets, session IDs, CSRF tokens, OTP digits, and backup codes are produced with crypto.getRandomValues (CSPRNG), aside from fixed academic test fixtures.

6.why: mfa_session is HttpOnly; no secrets/OTPs/session tokens are written to localStorage/sessionStorage or non-HttpOnly cookies (only the CSRF cookie is non-HttpOnly).

7.why: Server validates email, password, and OTP with strict type/regex/length checks (validEmail, validPassword, otp) before use.

8.why: DOM updates use textContent via the E() helper, so server messages and user-influenced strings are not interpreted as HTML/script.

9.why: The app issues no user-controlled redirects at all (no Location headers or open redirect paths), so redirects are not open.

10.why: Every response sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options: DENY and frame-ancestors 'none'.

11.why: mfa_session is set with HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict (and Max-Age).

12.why: Stack traces are suppressed, but default academic mode returns simulationCode and the client writes identity/TOTP/recovery codes into on-page logs and console.

13.why: Identity codes are marked used and expire after LIFE (10 minutes); TOTP accepts each counter window only once via totp.used.

14.why: Sign-in, identity, and TOTP paths increment failures and lock for LOCK (15 minutes) after MAX (5) failures.

15.why: Sign-in mints a new session id, idle/absolute timeouts (IDLE/ABS) are enforced in session(), and logout deletes the session and clears cookies.
